name: Google Calendar MCP
description: Google Calendar integration for scheduling interviews, setting follow-up reminders, and tracking availability. Automatically suggests open slots and creates events with prep notes.

tools.name: list_events
tools.description: List upcoming calendar events to check availability

tools.name: create_event
tools.description: Create interview or follow-up reminder events

tools.name: suggest_time
tools.description: Suggest available meeting slots to share with recruiters

tools.name: get_event
tools.description: Get details of a specific event

notes: Authenticated via Google OAuth. Use suggest_time to propose slots; create_event to log confirmed interviews with prep notes in description.

changelog.notes: Initial Google Calendar MCP for interview scheduling.
